source.label: Gottlieb Class of 1812 manual rules extract

strategy.summary: Take the available right-ramp Crypt lock, then repeat the left ramp for 1 million during two-ball Multiball. To relight Multiball, complete the left drop bank, collect Zom-B Bonus, complete the bank again, and return to the right-ramp lock.

quickInfo.name: Multiball Madness
quickInfo.summary: Take the available right-ramp lock and plunge the replacement ball for two-ball play. During Multiball, each left ramp scores 1 million.

quickInfo.name: Relight Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Complete the left drop bank, collect Zom-B Bonus at the flashing left target, complete the bank again, then lock at the right ramp.

quickInfo.name: C-O-F-F-I-N Jackpot
quickInfo.summary: Either lit ramp adds a letter, consecutive ramps escalate, and completing the word scores a fixed 2 million.

quickInfo.name: Countdown Round
quickInfo.summary: Complete the left drops, then finish the flashing left spot-target sequence for the displayed countdown value.

quickInfo.name: Million Round
quickInfo.summary: Complete the right drops, then finish the flashing right spot-target sequence for 2 million and a restarted timer.

quickInfo.name: BAT-O-METER
quickInfo.summary: Complete the three center spot targets to raise the spinner value.

steps.text: Test both ramps, the two drop banks, the top kicker, and the bottom upkicker before choosing a repeatable route.
Backhand the available right-ramp Crypt lock when that shot is stable; plunge the replacement ball to start two-ball Multiball Madness.
During Multiball, repeat the left ramp for 1 million whenever its return is controlled.
After Multiball, complete the left drop bank and hit the flashing left target to collect Zom-B Bonus.
Complete the left drop bank again to relight the Crypt lock, then return to the right ramp and repeat the Multiball route.
Take lit ramps for C-O-F-F-I-N letters and its fixed 2-million Jackpot when those shots fit the Multiball route; do not abandon a controlled left-ramp million to chase it.

fallback.title: BAT-O-METER spinner route
fallback.when: Use this when both ramps and the drop banks reject but the center spots and spinner return safely.

steps.text: Complete the three center spot targets to advance the BAT-O-METER.
Shoot the spinner only from a controlled feed and keep raising its displayed value.
Use the top rollovers for Bonus X only when the upper feed is predictable.

alternatives.title: C-O-F-F-I-N Jackpot
alternatives.when: Use this when both lit ramps are repeatable but Multiball is not ready.

steps.text: Shoot either lit ramp to add a C-O-F-F-I-N letter.
Keep using controlled consecutive ramps until the word is complete.
Complete C-O-F-F-I-N to collect the fixed 2-million Jackpot.

alternatives.title: Million Round pivot
alternatives.when: Use this when the right drop bank and right spot targets are safer than either ramp.

steps.text: Complete the four right drop targets to start Million Round.
Finish the flashing right spot-target sequence for 2 million and a fresh timer.
Repeat only while the required spot-target return remains controlled.
Complete the left drop bank and collect Zom-B Bonus at the flashing left target.
Complete the left drop bank again to relight the right-ramp Crypt lock.
Lock at the right ramp and plunge the replacement ball for Multiball.
Repeat the left ramp for 1 million while both balls remain in play.

techniques.name: Backhand
techniques.instruction: Backhand the right-ramp Crypt lock when the same-side angle is repeatable; transfer only when that shot rejects.

techniques.name: Ramp-loop control
techniques.instruction: After a clean left-ramp return, repeat the ramp only while the ball reaches the same controllable flipper position.

cautions.issue: The drop banks and right-ramp lock can reject unpredictably on worn copies.
cautions.response: Test registration and return direction before committing to repeated shots.

cautions.issue: Consecutive-ramp scoring and the ramp-sequence start are adjustable.
cautions.response: Read the lamps and display before treating a remembered ramp count as exact.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm ball count, Extra Ball conversion, lock difficulty, Multiball save, and whether the opening Crypt lock is flashing.
Test both ramps, both drop banks, the top kicker, bottom upkicker, spinner, and spot-target registration before choosing a route.
strategy.simpleOverview: Class of 1812 gives you an available right-ramp Crypt lock at the start. Lock the ball, plunge into two-ball Multiball, and repeat the left ramp for 1 million. After Multiball, use the left drop bank and Zom-B Bonus sequence to relight the lock.
strategy.overview: Take the available right-ramp Crypt lock, then repeat the left ramp for 1 million during two-ball Multiball. To relight the lock, complete the left drop bank, collect Zom-B Bonus at the flashing left target, complete the bank again, and return to the right ramp. Spell C-O-F-F-I-N and use the timed drop-bank rounds for additional scoring.
